usage: Usually refers to a professional who gives advice or specialized opinions, often on business, management, finance, IT, or education.
Can be used after a field or company name, like a role title: X 顧問.
Sounds fairly neutral and common in office/business contexts; it is not informal slang.
In daily speech, people may shorten the job idea with other role words, but 顧問 is the standard word when the person mainly advises rather than does hands-on work.
